m: Mash: boil the peeled potatoes 15 to 18 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the butter, milk and salt.
Brown the mince hard in a big pan. Add the diced onion and carrot and cook 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the Worcestershire and stock powder dissolved in ½ cup water per serve.
Simmer 15 minutes. Add the peas, and thicken with the cornflour mixed into a little cold water. Season well.
Oven to 200°C. Spoon the beef into a baking dish, spread the mash on top, rough it up with a fork and cover with cheese.
Bake 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes.
l: Cut into portions once cool. Reheats perfectly.
g: Check the Worcestershire sauce (some aren't GF), the stock powder and the cornflour (100% maize).
